lines: The team extends its condolences to the families of all of the heroes of the city who gave their lives in the multiple incidents that have taken place in major points in the city over the past weeks.
Their deaths were deeply regrettable, but just as the revolution that took place years ago, our current fight must continue on, no matter the costs.
However, their names will always be remembered and held dearly in our hearts.
Here, we will continue yesterday's segment to commemorate the names of those who lost their lives in the raid last week….
